rv.q: Let’s play "Name That Play." I’ll give you a plot synopsis; you tell me the title of the agreeably acted, audience-friendly and finger-slender revival that opened on Broadway last night at the Booth Theater. Frances Sternhagen and George Grizzard in the revival of the Edward Albee play "Seascape," which opened last night at the Booth Theater.
